note: agent-decomposed 2026-11-21 (stasis round 2). Draft design; its four delivery stages are executed by plans__2026-10-14-portable-app-migration-plan (decomposed this round). Items here are the design commitments; each points at the plan item that carries it rather than duplicating the work.

items.text: Foundation: shared interfaces, refusing default adapters, bounded demand leases in elohim-seam-contracts
Che access: compose device consent, browser session exchange and peer-side scoped permission independently
Che access: authenticated outbound WSS service attachment to doorway HTTPS; retire the fragment-capability launcher after both paths pass
Rakia adoption: compatible artifacts with complete dependency set, start under Ark, versioned continuation with operation dedup; original runtime kept until handoff
Residency: follow/reside/carry distinct; reclaim only unpinned executable bytes; offline needs verified executables plus data
Platform integration: inventory first-party bundles from manifests; resident services outside app windows under Ark
ObservationEmitter durable local append before ack, dedup, own-device reconciliation; dashboard refresh via demand leases
Acceptance chain genesis/a2o/features/devflow/portable-app-lifecycle.feature passes against real authorized runtimes and cold offline clients (graduation)
